en: 1 Samuel 8

p.src: 1  When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

ja: たちをイスラエルをさばく者とした。
en: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
u.src: 1  When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

p.src: 2  Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

ja: らはベエル・シェバでさばいていた。
en: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
u.src: 2  Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

p.src: 3  His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

en: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.
u.src: 3  His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

p.src: 4  Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.

ja: まり、ラマにいるサムエルのところに
en: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.
u.src: 4  Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.

p.src: 5  They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

en: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”
u.src: 5  They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

p.src: 6  But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to the LORD.

ja: った時、サムエルはその言葉を不快に
en: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to the LORD.
u.src: 6  But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to the LORD.

p.src: 7  The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.

ja: うすべてのことについて、彼らの
けたのはあなたではない。わたしが
en: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.
u.src: 7  The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.

p.src: 8  According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

ja: らが行ってきたすべての行いのとおりである。彼らはわたしを
えたように、あなたにもそのようにしている。
en: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.
u.src: 8  According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

p.src: 9  Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”

ja: いなさい。しかし、彼らに
en: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”
u.src: 9  Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”

p.src: 10  Samuel told all the LORD’s words to the people who asked him for a king.

en: Samuel told all the LORD’s words to the people who asked him for a king.
u.src: 10  Samuel told all the LORD’s words to the people who asked him for a king.

p.src: 11  He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.

en: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.
u.src: 11  He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.

p.src: 12  He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.

ja: 命する。また一部の者を、
en: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.
u.src: 12  He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.

p.src: 13  He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.

en: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.
u.src: 13  He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.

p.src: 14  He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.

en: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.
u.src: 14  He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.

p.src: 15  He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

ja: 彼はあなたがたの穀物とぶどう
en: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.
u.src: 15  He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

p.src: 16  He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.

ja: たち、またあなたがたのろばを
en: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.
u.src: 16  He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.

p.src: 17  He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

en: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.
u.src: 17  He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

p.src: 18  You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and the LORD will not answer you in that day.”

ja: めるであろうが、主はその
en: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and the LORD will not answer you in that day.”
u.src: 18  You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and the LORD will not answer you in that day.”

p.src: 19  But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,

がいなければならない。
en: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,
u.src: 19  But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,

p.src: 20  that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”

en: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”

p.src: 21  Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.

en: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.

p.src: 22  The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”

en: The LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”
